title: Limit descent with compatibility witness
statement: Under the hypotheses of finite étale lifting over a henselian pair, there exists a finite étale lift together with a compatibility witness for the limit construction.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma Tag 0GS2 (lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair, line 1749), proof, paragraph 'General case', essential surjectivity (Limits 0A0P, More on Algebra 07PX, 0A04, 0AH3, Limits 01ZM, 01ZO, 07RP)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-henselian-g-ring-stage] to obtain a henselian G-ring pair (B,J), proper g:Z -> Spec B, W over Z_0, maps s and k with j_Y followed by s equal to k followed by j_Z, and an isomorphism W pulled back along k with V over Y_0.

Apply the hypothesis H to B, J, g and W, obtaining finite etale T over Z and an isomorphism of its closed fibre with W. Set U to the pullback of T along s. Finiteness and etaleness are stable under base change by [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category].

Paste the pullback of T along s with the closed fibre of Y. The canonical pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso identifies this with T pulled back along j_Y followed by s. Rewrite this composite using the compatibility equality, then apply the inverse pasting isomorphism to obtain the pullback along k of the closed fibre of T. Each isomorphism respects the projection to Y_0 by the projection equations for pullback pasting and pullback.congrHom. Apply the ordinary Over.pullback k functor to the isomorphism supplied by H and compose with the stage-cover isomorphism to V. This gives the required isomorphism over Y_0. Supply Iso.refl Y for the final compatibility witness.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_henselianPair_of_gRing_lifting_core
    (H : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B], IsGRing B →
      ∀ (J : Ideal B) [HenselianRing B J] (Z : Scheme.{u})
        (g : Z ⟶ Spec (.of B)) [IsProper g]
        (W : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤
          (pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))))),
        ∃ U' : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ Z,
          Nonempty
            (Over.mk (pullback.snd U'.hom
              (pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))))) ≅
              Over.mk W.hom))
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [HenselianRing A I]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f]
    (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤
      (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) :
    ∃ U : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ Y,
      Nonempty
        (Over.mk (pullback.snd U.hom
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) ≅
          Over.mk V.hom) ∧ Nonempty (Y ≅ Y)
